api.command: CLOUDFLARE_INCLUDE_PROCESS_ENV=true npx hush run -t api-workers -- pnpm --filter @slopcade/api dev

metro.comment: Slopcade brand Metro (port 8085). Stop metro-amen first if running: devmux stop metro-amen.
metro.command: node ../../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --dev-client --port 8085

metro-amen.comment: Amen brand Metro (port 8085). Stop metro first if running: devmux stop metro. Always clears Metro cache (BRAND_ID is baked into the bundle).
metro-amen.command: node ../../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --dev-client --port 8085 --clear

ios.comment: Build + install slopcade on iOS simulator. One-shot: exits when done. Starts metro if not running.
ios.command: RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx expo run:ios --no-bundler

ios-amen.comment: Build + install amen on iOS simulator. Prebuilds ios/ for amen (bundle: games.amen.app).
ios-amen.command: npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx expo run:ios --no-bundler

web.command: node ../../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --web --port 8085

web-amen.comment: Amen brand web. Kills web if running first (same port 8085).
web-amen.command: node ../../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --web --port 8085 --clear

storybook.command: npx hush run -t app -- pnpm storybook
